name: Eventbrite logo-only Open Graph card by eventbrite.com
description: A 1200×630 social card reduced to a single gesture: a flat white canvas with the lowercase "eventbrite" wordmark in warm coral-orange, optically centered and floated slightly above the vertical midpoint. There is no tagline, URL or imagery — the geometric rounded sans, with its tilted "t" ascender and round tittle, does all the recognition work, while roughly 60% negative space keeps the mark crisp even at thumbnail scale. Hierarchy is achieved purely through one saturated hue against one neutral, with no shadows, gradients or borders.
